en: Give the actual Swanbourne address privately when arranging an assessment, together with entry instructions, occupied rooms and the person authorised to approve work. Western suburbs is a broad service-region label, so include the suburb or postcode for enquiries outside Swanbourne. Tell us your suburb or postcode so we can discuss the visit with you. We confirm the proposed location, work scope, safe access and written quote directly before a booking proceeds.
Tell us the property suburb or postcode and the repairs needed. We confirm the assessment location and access with you, then provide the written repair scope and quote after the site assessment.
zh: 安排评估时请私下提供实际 Swanbourne 地址，以及进场指引、有人使用的房间和授权审批人。Western Suburbs 是宽泛服务区域名称，因此 Swanbourne 以外咨询请注明城区名称或邮编。请告知所在城区或邮编，方便我们与您沟通上门安排。预约前 Ellis 会直接确认拟服务地点、工作范围、安全进场条件及书面报价。
请告诉我们物业所在地区或邮编，以及需要处理的维修。我们会先与您确认评估地点及进场安排，现场评估后再提供书面维修范围和报价。

en: Confirm removal and disposal of the old door, suitable trimming, hardware fitting and the final finish. Painting, frame repairs and regulated lock work must be identified separately rather than assumed to be included in every installation.

We set out the agreed old-door removal and disposal, suitable trimming, hardware fitting and finish in your quote. We identify painting, frame repairs and regulated lock work separately, including any additional charges.
zh: 请确认旧门拆除与清运、合适的修边、五金安装及最终饰面。油漆、门框维修及受监管的锁具工作须单独列明，不能默认每项门安装都已包含。
我们会在报价中列明商定的旧门拆除与清运、适当修边、五金安装及饰面。油漆、门框维修和受监管锁具工作会分别列明，并说明另行计费的项目。

en: We measure the opening and check the frame, surrounding finish and access before agreeing a replacement window. The frame material, glazing and opening style form part of the specification; changes to the structural opening require separate assessment.

We measure the opening and inspect the frame, surrounding finishes and access before recommending a replacement. Your quote identifies the frame material, glazing and opening style. Any change to the structural opening is assessed and quoted separately.
zh: Ellis 会现场测量洞口，检查窗框、周边饰面及进场条件，再确认更换方案。规格中会注明窗框材料、玻璃及开启方式；改变结构洞口须另行评估。
我们会现场测量洞口，检查窗框、周边饰面及进场条件，再说明更换方案。报价会列明窗框材料、玻璃及开启方式；如需改动结构洞口，我们会单独评估并报价。

en: A sticking sash or worn fitting may suit repair instead of full replacement. Extensive frame damage, deterioration or a different window design can change the recommendation. Compare the existing condition with the proposed result before ordering.

We inspect sticking sashes, worn fittings and frame condition to explain whether repair or replacement suits your window. We discuss deterioration, any design changes and the finish you want before you order a replacement.
zh: 窗扇卡住或配件磨损，有时可以维修而不必整窗更换。窗框大面积损坏、材料老化或窗型改变，可能需要不同方案。订购前应结合现状与您希望达到的效果作决定。
我们会检查卡滞窗扇、磨损配件及窗框状况，说明适合维修还是更换。订购替换窗前，我们会与您沟通老化情况、窗型改动及期望的完成效果。

en: Supply and install or installation only
Window supply and installation arrangements

窗户供货与安装安排

My apartment balcony door is jammed. What details should I provide?

公寓阳台门卡住，咨询时应提供哪些信息？

Do you provide instant online quotes?

What should I tell your team about a circuit that keeps tripping?

What details should I provide about a roof leak?

咨询屋顶漏水时应提供哪些信息？

en: The price depends on the hole size, board condition, access and required finish. We assess the damage and quotes the patching and any agreed painting separately in the scope. Matching an old painted surface may require finishing beyond the patch itself.
We assess the damage and quote for patching and any agreed painting separately in the scope. Tell us the damaged area, existing finish and the result you want.
zh: 取决于孔洞大小、板材状况、进场及所需效果。我们评估损伤，并在范围内分别列明修补和商定油漆。匹配旧漆面可能需扩大到修补处以外。
我们会检查损坏情况，在施工范围中分别列明修补及商定的油漆报价。请说明受损区域、现有饰面及期望效果。

en: The photographs show the fitted door hardware from both sides. Its operation and security performance cannot be established from the images.
The photographs show the fitted door hardware from both sides. For your door, we check the hardware, fit and applicable security requirements before agreeing the work.
zh: 照片展示已装门五金的两侧，无法从图片确定操作性能及防盗表现。
照片展示已安装门五金的两侧。针对您的门，我们会先检查五金、安装配合及适用的安防要求，再商定工作。

en: Ellis door hardware removal and smart-lock fitting photographs show the visible work scope and limits of what the fitted hardware images establish.
See door-hardware removal and smart-lock fitting details, and how we assess the door, hardware and requirements for a similar job.
zh: Ellis 门五金拆卸及智能锁安装照片展示可见工作范围，并说明仅凭安装照片能确定什么、不能确定什么。
查看门五金拆卸和智能锁安装细节，了解我们如何评估类似工作的门体、五金及施工要求。

en: Ellis living-room wall repair and painting photographs show damaged surfaces, preparation and the finished wall, with scope and evidence notes.
See interior wall patching, preparation and painting photographs. We assess the damaged area and finish for your repair.
zh: Ellis 客厅墙面修补及油漆照片展示受损表面、基层处理和完工墙面，并附范围与证据说明。
查看室内墙面修补、基层处理及油漆照片。我们会按您的受损区域和饰面需求评估维修。

en: The finished room view shows a refreshed painted wall. The photographs show the surface presentation without establishing the cause of the original damage.
The photographs show the wall damage, preparation and finished painted surface. For a similar repair, we check the wall condition and discuss patching, preparation and the paint finish with you.
zh: 完工房间展示焕新油漆墙面。照片仅显示表面外观，不能确定原损伤原因。
照片展示墙面损坏、基层处理及完成后的油漆表面。针对类似维修，我们会检查墙体状况，并与您确认修补、准备及油漆饰面。

en: The final photograph shows the cabinet door aligned with the neighbouring fronts. Longer-term hinge performance is not established by a photograph.
The photographs show the repaired hinge and aligned cabinet doors. For your cabinet, we inspect the hinges, fixings and supporting board before confirming the repair and adjustment.
zh: 最后照片展示柜门与相邻门面齐平。照片不能确定铰链长期性能。
照片展示维修后的铰链及调齐的柜门。针对您的橱柜，我们会检查铰链、固定件及支撑柜板，再确认维修和调整方案。

en: Ask for patching, preparation and paint work to be itemised. Hole size, backing, damaged edges and the agreed finish affect cost. A local touch-up and painting the full wall are different decisions; an invisible match is not assumed.

We itemise patching, preparation and any agreed painting in your quote. We check the hole, backing and damaged edges, then discuss a local touch-up or wider repaint so the repair and finish are clear.
zh: 请要求将修补、准备及油漆分别列项。孔洞大小、背后支撑、受损边缘及商定饰面都会影响费用。局部补漆与整墙刷漆是不同决定；不能默认无痕匹配。
我们会在报价中分别列明修补、基层处理及商定的油漆工作。检查孔洞、背后支撑和受损边缘后，我们会与您讨论局部补漆或扩大重刷，让维修及饰面范围清楚明确。

en: We first agree what can be assessed accessibly and whether further investigation is needed. Tile removal cannot be ruled out before the cause is understood. The quote separates diagnosis, plumbing, membrane work and replacement finishes; it does not promise an invisible or no-tile-removal cure. Read our wet-area repair distinctions.

We first assess the accessible area and explain any further investigation needed. Once we identify the cause, we set out any tile removal, plumbing, membrane work and replacement finishes in the quote.
zh: 我们会先商定可接近部位的评估，以及是否需进一步调查。原因未明前，不能排除拆砖。报价会区分诊断、管道、防水层工程及替换饰面，不承诺无痕或免拆砖解决。请阅读我们的 湿区维修区别.
我们会先检查可接近的区域，并说明所需的进一步排查。查明原因后，我们会在报价中列明所需的瓷砖拆除、管道、防水层及饰面恢复工作。

en: Yes, if assessment shows the support or retained fence is unsuitable. We explain the changed scope and seeks approval before replacement. Measurements and photos already available are optional; the site assessment establishes the proposed run.

If assessment shows the supports or retained fence need replacement, we explain the revised work and price and obtain your approval before proceeding. Existing measurements and photos are optional; we measure the proposed fence run on site.
zh: 可以，如评估显示支撑或保留围栏不适用。Ellis 会解释范围变化，并在更换前申请批准。已有尺寸和照片可自愿提供；现场评估会确定拟更换围栏段。
如检查发现支撑或保留围栏需要更换，我们会先说明调整后的工作及价格，取得您的批准后再施工。已有尺寸和照片可自愿提供；我们会现场测量拟更换的围栏段。

en: That depends on the retained posts, rails and available matching timber. Confirm the affected length, access and approval contact before quoting. See our existing timber fence repair example for repair evidence.

We check the posts, rails and available matching timber to explain whether a local repair is suitable. We measure the affected section, confirm access and approval arrangements, then provide the repair quote.
zh: 这取决于保留立柱、横梁及可取得的匹配木材。报价前请确认受影响长度、进场及审批联系人。请参阅我们的 现有木围栏维修案例 了解维修证据。
我们会检查立柱、横梁及匹配木材供应，说明是否适合局部维修。现场测量受影响部分、确认进场和审批安排后，我们会提供维修报价。

en: Approved nail-hole patches, local wall damage, skirting and flyscreen mesh. Confirm any patching and paint finish in the quote. Recurring cracks, dampness or movement need assessment before a cosmetic finish is chosen.

We assess approved nail-hole patches, local wall damage, skirting and flyscreen mesh. We specify patching and painting in your quote and investigate recurring cracks, damp or movement before recommending a finish.
zh: 获批的钉孔修补、局部墙面损坏、踢脚线及纱窗网。在报价中确认具体修补及涂漆饰面。反复裂缝、潮湿或位移须先评估，再决定是否进行表面修复。
我们会评估获批的钉孔修补、局部墙损、踢脚线及纱窗网，在报价中列明修补和油漆工作。对于反复裂缝、潮湿或位移，我们会先检查原因，再说明饰面方案。

en: Review the accepted tasks, materials and exclusions with the person authorised to approve the work. Confirm any purchase-order requirement and the completion information requested.
We review the tasks, materials and exclusions with the authorised contact and set them out in your quote. We also agree any purchase-order requirement and the completion information you need.
zh: 由有权批准施工的人员核对承接任务、材料和排除项目。确认是否需要采购订单及要求提供哪些完工资料。
我们会与授权联系人核对工作、材料及不包含项，并在报价中列明，同时商定采购订单要求及您需要的完工资料。

en: When overflow persists, junctions leak or falls and drainage connections need alteration, the scope goes beyond clearing debris. We identify the appropriate own-team personnel and separate assessment, cleaning and repair work in the quote.

When overflow persists, junctions leak or drainage falls and connections need alteration, we assess the drainage system as well as debris build-up. Our appropriately licensed employees handle the regulated work, with assessment, cleaning and repairs listed separately in your quote.
zh: 持续溢流、节点漏水或需调整坡度及排水连接时，范围已超出清除杂物。Ellis 会确定适当自有团队人员，并在报价中区分评估、清洁及维修。
持续溢流、节点漏水或需要调整坡度及排水连接时，我们会同时检查排水系统和杂物堆积。受监管工作由我们具备相应执照的员工完成，报价会分别列明评估、清洁及维修。

en: Start with the affected system: power and lighting, water and drains, gas appliances or air conditioning. Describe symptoms rather than trying to diagnose them. We check the installation and confirm the required work with our own appropriately licensed personnel for regulated tasks.
We check the installation and confirm the required work with our own appropriately licensed employees for regulated tasks.
zh: 先说明受影响系统：电源与照明、供水与排水、燃气设备或空调。描述现象即可，无需自行诊断。我们会检查安装并确认所需工程；受监管任务由其自有、具备相应牌照的人员处理。
我们会检查现有设施并确认所需工程；受监管工作由我们自有、具备相应执照的员工完成。

en: Disconnect power and stop using an appliance that is leaking onto electrical components, smoking or overheating; electrical and plumbing work may require licensed Ellis team members.

Stop using an appliance that is leaking onto electrical components, smoking or overheating. Disconnect power only where safe and do not touch wet electrical components. Our own appropriately licensed employees handle regulated electrical and plumbing work.
zh: 电器漏水到电气部件、冒烟或过热时，请断电并停止使用；电气及管道工程可能需要由 Ellis 持牌团队成员完成。
电器漏水到电气部件、冒烟或过热时，请停止使用。仅在安全情况下断电，勿触碰潮湿电气部件。受监管的电气及管道工作由我们自有、具备相应执照的员工完成。

en: Describe the damaged part and how the window operates. Local timber and hardware repairs differ from glass replacement. We assess the window and coordinate the appropriate own-team scope rather than assuming every fault is a glass job.
We assess the window and identify the timber, hardware and glazing work needed. Our team explains the repair scope and any separate glass replacement before you approve the quote.
zh: 请描述损坏部位及窗的操作情况。局部木材及五金维修不同于玻璃更换。我们会评估窗并协调合适的自有团队工作范围，不会假定每个故障都是玻璃问题。
我们会检查窗户，确定所需木材、五金及玻璃工作，并在您批准报价前说明维修范围及单独的玻璃更换项目。

en: We provide a written quote after an on-site assessment. Ask whether the job is priced by time or as a booking block, and which labour, materials and disposal costs are included. Additional repairs need their scope and price agreed before proceeding.

We provide a written quote after an on-site assessment. We explain whether the work is priced by time or a booking block and identify the labour, materials and disposal included. Additional repairs need their scope and price agreed before proceeding.
zh: 我们会在现场评估后提供书面报价。请确认按时间还是预约时段计价，以及包含哪些人工、材料和清运费用。新增维修需先商定范围及价格，再施工。
我们会在现场评估后提供书面报价，说明按时间还是预约时段计价，并列明包含的人工、材料及清运项目。新增维修会先与您商定范围及价格，再施工。

en: Handyman services suit defined minor maintenance, assembly, mounting and repair tasks that do not cross into regulated or specialist trade work.

We handle defined minor maintenance, assembly, mounting and repair tasks. Electrical, plumbing, gas and other regulated work is assessed separately and completed by our own appropriately licensed employees.
zh: 家居维修适合范围明确的小型维护、组装、安装和维修任务，不应超出范围涉及受监管或专门专业工种工程。
我们提供范围明确的小型维护、组装、安装及维修。电气、管道、燃气及其他受监管工作会分别评估，由我们自有、具备相应执照的员工完成。

en: Gas-fitting services cover appliance connections, gas leaks, pipework and alterations that require controlled testing and compliant work.

We connect, replace and disconnect compatible gas appliances and assess non-emergency pipework and installation faults. Our own appropriately licensed gas fitters confirm the work and required testing.
zh: 燃气安装服务涵盖设备连接、燃气泄漏、管道及改动，须进行受控测试并按规定施工。
我们提供适配燃气设备的连接、更换和断开，并评估非紧急管道及安装故障。工作及所需测试由我们自有、具备相应执照的燃气安装工确认。

en: Investigate a reported gas odour or suspected installation fault
Assess non-emergency appliance, pipework and installation faults
zh: 调查报告的燃气气味或疑似安装故障
评估非紧急燃气设备、管道及安装故障

We check the items on site and confirm suitable work in the written quote. Give the actual suburb or postcode, access contact and priority items so the assessment can address the property itself rather than rely on the regional description.

We check the items on site and confirm suitable work in the written quote. Give the actual suburb or postcode, access contact and priority items so the assessment can address the property itself rather than rely on the regional description.
zh: 对于成熟社区房屋，请说明希望保留哪些窗户、饰条或饰面。维修、局部更换与整体升级需要不同的材料及收尾处理。Ellis 会现场检查，并在书面报价中确认适合的工作。请提供实际城区名称或邮编、进场联系人及优先事项，让评估依据房屋实际情况进行，而非仅依赖区域描述。
对于成熟社区房屋，请说明希望保留哪些窗户、饰条或饰面。维修、局部更换与整体升级需要不同的材料及收尾处理。我们会现场检查，并在书面报价中确认适合的工作。请提供实际城区名称或邮编、进场联系人及优先事项，让评估依据房屋实际情况进行，而非仅依赖区域描述。

en: For an established home, a loose hinge or damaged timber edge needs more information than the room name. Note whether the screw fixing, hinge, door edge or frame appears affected. If the problem has returned after an earlier repair, mention that history. We check the surrounding material before agreeing a repair, because replacing hardware alone may not address a damaged fixing surface.

For an established home, a loose hinge or damaged timber edge needs more information than the room name. Note whether the screw fixing, hinge, door edge or frame appears affected. If the problem has returned after an earlier repair, mention that history. zh: 成熟住宅出现铰链松动或木边损坏时，除了房间名称，还需补充具体信息。请指出看起来受影响的是螺钉固定处、铰链、门边还是门框。如曾修过而问题再次出现，请说明历史情况。Ellis 会先检查周边材质再商定维修，因为仅更换五金未必能解决固定面损坏。
成熟住宅出现铰链松动或木边损坏时，除了房间名称，还需补充具体信息。请指出看起来受影响的是螺钉固定处、铰链、门边还是门框。如曾修过而问题再次出现，请说明历史情况。我们会先检查周边材质再商定维修，因为仅更换五金未必能解决固定面损坏。

en: For Mundaring and Kalamunda home maintenance, distinguish the repair symptom from the access needed to inspect it. A gutter overflowing after rain, a door catching on its frame and a damaged flyscreen belong on separate lines of the repair list. Describe what you can observe from a safe position and the part of the property affected. We assess the condition on site before agreeing the method, materials or written quote.

en: A power-point replacement and new fixed wiring belong to electrical work, while a tap or leaking sink belongs to plumbing assessment. Ellis’s own appropriately licensed personnel complete the regulated scope; a handyman name alone establishes no qualification.

Our own appropriately licensed employees handle electrical and plumbing work. We assess power points, fixed wiring, taps and leaks under their respective trade scopes and set out the agreed work in your written quote.
zh: 插座更换及新增固定布线属于电气工作，水龙头或水槽漏水属于管道评估。受监管范围由 Ellis 自有、具备相应牌照的人员完成；家居维修名称本身不能证明资格。
电气和管道工作由我们自有、具备相应执照的员工完成。我们会按对应工种分别评估插座、固定线路、水龙头及漏水问题，并在书面报价中列明商定工作。

en: A handyman business name does not establish plumbing or electrical licensing. The person and work scope must meet the relevant requirements. We identify our own appropriately licensed personnel for regulated tasks rather than treating all small-looking repairs as unregulated.

Our own appropriately licensed employees carry out regulated electrical and plumbing work. We identify each task and its required qualifications separately from minor repairs before agreeing the work.

受监管的电气和管道工作由我们自有、具备相应执照的员工完成。商定工作前，我们会将各项任务及所需资质与普通小修分别说明。

en: Describe all the faults together, but the regulated tasks need their appropriate own-team personnel and scopes. We separate electrical and plumbing work from ordinary repairs; a general handyman booking does not authorise someone without the relevant qualifications.

Tell us the full repair list. We assess electrical and plumbing work separately from ordinary repairs and arrange our own appropriately licensed employees for the regulated tasks. Your quote sets out the agreed scope.
zh: 可以一并描述所有故障，但受监管任务需要适当的自有团队人员及工作范围。Ellis 会将电气和管道工作与普通维修分开；一般家居维修预约并不授权缺乏相关资格的人员施工。
请告诉我们完整维修清单。我们会将电气和管道工作与普通维修分别评估，并安排自有、具备相应执照的员工完成受监管任务。报价会列明商定范围。
